title: Correlation Study Between Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Response and Long-Term Prognosis in Breast Cancer Based on Deep Learning Models.
summary: A retrospective 832-patient breast-cancer cohort used an MLP to predict five-year recurrence/metastasis after neoadjuvant chemotherapy; the model reported internal cross-validated discrimination across subtypes.
ai_technology: A PyTorch MLP integrated molecular subtype, grade, tumor-size reduction, nodal status, Miller–Payne grade, Ki-67 and surgery; five-fold CV and SHAP were used.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: The study predicts recorded five-year recurrence/metastasis; MLP AUC 0.86 (95% CI 0.81–0.92), accuracy 0.86, F1 0.84; a retrospective result, not treatment effect.
evidence.unknown: Five-fold internal CV was reported on 832 patients from one retrospective cohort. No external or prospective validation is established; evidence supports only the source-reported prognostic result.
evidence.ai_role: A PyTorch MLP integrated molecular subtype, grade, tumor-size reduction, nodal status, Miller–Payne grade, Ki-67 and surgery; five-fold CV and SHAP were used.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
